Context: 3. Seniority of reverted and promoted officers

## 3. Seniority of reverted and promoted officers  
- 3.1. Penalty of Reversion.In cases where a Government servant is reverted to a lower post, grade, or service as a penalty and subsequently promoted to a higher post, the order imposing the penalty should specify the period of reduction and whether the Government servant will regain their original seniority upon re-promotion.
